verdict.rationale: Drata publishes a well-documented Public API v2 with OAuth setup, extensive endpoint references (Personnel, Devices, Controls, Risks, Custom Connections, etc.) and even messaging about enabling AI agents to interact with Drata, which supports building AI-native integrations. However, the evidence never mentions dedicated official SDKs (e.g., Python/Node/Go client libraries) and probes show the OpenAPI spec/llms.txt are not directly machine-fetchable (404s), suggesting only human-facing API reference docs rather than packaged SDKs. missing for 10: explicit language-specific SDK packages, publicly accessible machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
